sources.title: LangChain OpenWiki (github.com/langchain-ai/openwiki)
sources.keyClaim: Self-maintaining wiki built for agents and explored by humans; synthesizes linked Markdown wiki from source; supports codebase + personal knowledge modes; generates interactive visual knowledge graph; updates through GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Bitbucket Pipelines.

sources.title: Onyx Agent Wiki (github.com/onyx-dot-app/agent-wiki)
sources.keyClaim: Self-updating knowledge base; Markdown canonical; filesystem hierarchy organizational model; Git as history; MCP for agent updates; APIs for external ingestion; human editing; automatic reconciliation; page/folder-specific update policies; event triggers.

sources.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows — Documentation Automation (github.github.com/gh-aw/guides/docs-automation/)
sources.keyClaim: Safe automated docs maintenance pattern: code changes → documentation agent detects drift → proposes documentation changes → reviewable PR → merge. Never silent rewrite.

sources.title: Mintlify docs (github.com/mintlify/docs) — changelog.mdx
sources.keyClaim: Feb 2026 updates: documentation automations (scheduled/event-driven). Aug 2026 updates: user-journey analytics (routes, searches, chat behavior). Documentation information architecture; AI-agent interfaces; MCP access.

sources.title: Backstage — Technical Overview (github.com/backstage/backstage)
sources.keyClaim: Catalog/metadata/relationship architecture; centralized catalog; extensible plugin architecture. Technical documentation: easy to create, maintain, find, and use through structured relationships.

sources.title: Tour Kit (github.com/domidex01/tour-kit)
sources.keyClaim: Headless onboarding and product tour library for React. Combines tours, persistent hints, onboarding checklists, announcements, microsurveys, feature adoption, analytics, AI Q&A. TypeScript/React oriented.

sources.title: UserTour (github.com/usertour/usertour)
sources.keyClaim: Open-source user onboarding platform. Allows creating in-app product tours, checklists, surveys in minutes. Self-hosted. Open-source alternative to Userflow and Appcues.

sources.title: Frigade — JavaScript SDK (github.com/FrigadeHQ/javascript)
sources.keyClaim: Platform for building high-quality product onboarding with React. Product tours, getting started checklists, banners, and more. Customer journey model: Registration → Activation → Adoption → Engagement → Retention. Tracks onboarding state and customer journeys.
